source_text.literal_excerpt: Recent software development in word processors and database managers has helped solve this problem of how to manage and study multiple files at once. infrastructure_critique.technical_function: A full-text indexing engine that treats heterogeneous source files as one undifferentiated, keyword-searchable corpus, discarding provenance, format, and language metadata in favor of flat retrieval.
infrastructure_critique.gatekeeping_effect: Only content that has already been digitized into machine-readable, indexable text becomes 'findable' by the researcher; everything else -- oral testimony, non-English scripts, physical/ephemeral records -- is structurally invisible to the search, independent of its evidentiary value.

nested_complicity.note: Auditing this passage on full-text indexing required locating, searching, and excerpting a digitized copy of the text through the SRM platform. This project's own dataset then converts those excerpts into fixed, machine-searchable fields. The mechanism coded here is the mechanism used to code it. No alternative within this project's scope avoids that.

source_text.literal_excerpt: The primary researcher's role was reduced to setting up the protocol and then analyzing and interpreting data. The data collection and organization (coding) process was carried out by novices hired and quickly trained to find, record, and count the 'mentions' for each unit of analysis. Measures of 'intercoder reliability' would, presumably, show that the research novitiates were really using the same judgmental criteria... The upshot was that reliability produced validity.

infrastructure_critique.named_system_or_practice: Intercoder reliability protocol with trained novice coders
infrastructure_critique.technical_function: A protocol authored centrally, then executed by trained coders who record and count predefined units; agreement between coders is computed as a reliability statistic.
infrastructure_critique.gatekeeping_effect: Categories are fixed by the protocol author before coding begins; content that a counting task cannot register has no field to occupy, and agreement between coders may be treated as evidence of validity rather than of shared training.

nested_complicity.note: This unit codes intercoder reliability as substituting statistical agreement for contextual understanding. This project invokes Kirk and Miller's (1986) reliability standards, including a second-coder consensus check, as its own defense of rigor. The practice under critique is also the warrant being claimed. The project does not resolve this; abandoning the standard would weaken the auditability the project argues for, and retaining it reproduces the delegation it names.

infrastructure_critique.technical_function: Qualitative software organizes coded excerpts into a hierarchical tree of nodes and sub-nodes, requiring each excerpt to be filed under an existing or newly created node.
infrastructure_critique.gatekeeping_effect: An excerpt that does not fit an existing node, and for which the coder does not create a new one, has no location in the node tree and is effectively unretrievable within the software's own organization of the data.

nested_complicity.note: This unit audits polanco et al.'s account of vacuum-packing and node-tree coding as extractive. This project's own data model performs the same categorical filing operation polanco et al. describe, on Altheide's text and, in this record, on polanco et al.'s own text. The critique of vacuum-packing is here executed by vacuum-packing the critique itself into a coded record.
